Name: Hojichas Seaside Furniture and Wallpapers and Floors for Alternative Textures
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Hojichas' nautical and fishing themed furniture and wall paper. Converted to Alternative Textures which adds the pieces as new textures that you can apply to furniture in-game with a paint bucket, so you can have both vanilla and multiple types of...
Description:
This is an [Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description) content pack. This content packs will add texture variation to many furniture, wallpaper and floor objects in Stardew Valley. When placing supported objects, it has a chance to use the default game texture or one of the texture variations supplied by any AT content pack. If you'd like to change the texture of the placed item, you can use the Paint Bucket tool on it. This tool is purchasable from Robin.

All items in this pack are tagged "Hojichas" and "Seaside" to make them easier to find with the in-built search function.

This mod is compatible with most mods and is easy to install and uninstall. To install just drop it in your mods folder. To remove, just delete the folder. As a result it is possible to just use the furniture pack and not the wallpapers and flooring and vice versa, just delete the folders containing the assets you don't want.

_Credits:_

Thanks to Hojichas for giving permission to use the assets in this file without asking as long as credit is given.

In addition Much thanks to [Ayene](http://ayene-chan.deviantart.com/) for some of the flooring used since Hojichas used their art in the mod.Original furniture mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1189Original Wall and Floor mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/912Other mods pictured here are Yellog's furniture mods, but they've been taken off Nexus.
